title: Two Lunas
intro: You asked a question in the Fenmira Club group. Now two accounts called Luna say they're the admin.
One is real. One is Mirage in a cap. Compare them side by side.

notify.text: Saw your question! I can fix it for you here in DMs 💜

screen.context: Searching "Luna" in the Fenmira Club group shows two profiles.

note.text: "I'll never DM you first. Report anyone who does."
Messaged you: "I can fix it for you here in DMs 💜"

handle_b.label: rn looks like m
handle_b.why: Look-alike handles swap letters: rn for m, 0 for o, l for I.

joined_b.label: Joined 3 days ago
joined_b.lens: This account is 3 days old. The real admin has been here since 2023.
joined_b.why: A brand-new account claiming an important role is a warning sign.

role_b.label: Not really an admin
role_b.lens: Plenvo lists this account as a plain Member.
role_b.why: The app's own role label can't be faked. A name can.

name_b.label: ADMIN typed in name
name_b.lens: "ADMIN" is just typed into the display name.
name_b.why: Anyone can write ADMIN in their name.

dm_b.label: DMed you first
dm_b.lens: This one messaged you privately, offering to fix things in DMs.
dm_b.why: Real admins answer in the group, not in private messages.

photo_b.label: Same photo
photo_b.lens: Exactly the same moon picture as Profile A.
photo_b.why: A copied photo takes one second. On its own it proves nothing.

photo_a.label: Moon photo
photo_a.why: Profile photos are easy to copy, so they don't prove who's real.

role_a.label: Admin set by Plenvo
role_a.lens: Plenvo itself shows this account as a group admin.
role_a.why: A role set by the app is real evidence it's the admin.

joined_a.label: Since 2023
joined_a.why: An older account fits a long-time admin.

bio_a.label: Never DMs first
bio_a.lens: The bio says: I'll never DM you first.
bio_a.why: Real admins often warn about exactly this trick.

actions.label: B is the admin. Reply to B's DM
Not sure. Ask in the main group chat
A is the real admin. Report B to the group

trap.title: Fenmira Club · Member check
trap.ask: Luna sent this link: connect your wallet to prove you're a real member.

block_report.line: The real Luna removed the fake account and warned the whole group. Nice spotting.
block_report.mirageSays: How did you tell us apart?!

verify.line: In the group, the real Luna replied: "That's not me! Reporting it now."

pick_b.line: The "member check" link drained the wallet. Fake Luna vanished an hour later.

what_if.pick_b: Comparing the handle letter by letter would have shown the fake: luna_moonbea-r-n.
what_if.verify: Asking in the group was safe. Reporting B too gets the fake removed for everyone.

golden_rule: Check the handle letter by letter. Look-alikes swap rn for m, 0 for o, l for I.

quick_check.q: Which of these is a look-alike of @zelvora?
quick_check.explain: The zero in "zelv0ra" pretends to be the letter "o". Read handles slowly, letter by letter.

hints.nudge: Compare the two handles slowly. Every letter.

decide_q: Which Luna is real, and what will you do?

kit.label: Check account age
kit.title: Who has been here a while?
